reason: My rates move every morning and every big customer has his own price that I keep in my head, not in any Excel. If I have to WhatsApp rates daily and still fix every quote, I am just doing the same work twice, so I will keep replying from the IndiaMART app myself.
objection: An automatic quote will go out with the wrong price for the wrong customer, and in trading one wrong rate loses the margin or the customer. Rs 5,000 back does not cover that, and Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month is a lot for something my nephew's website already sort of does.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in front of me on my own phone: 10 of my real IndiaMART enquiries from this week drafted with the right rate for the right customer, without me first spending days building a price sheet, and a talk with that chemical trader saying it saved him time.
